changePassword.description: This should be used only when changing the password

id.description: Required to update an account, not required for new account

inboundRatePlanProductId.description: inboundRatePlanProductId is only required for accounts with toll-free numbers

extensionLength.description: Length of extension, not required for simple account

routePlanId.description: Route plan to be used to route outbound calls from this account

callScreeningSettings.description: Call Screening settings to be applied to all phone numbers on reception of inbound calls

domain.description: Overrides partition default brand which is used for end user emails and portal

sendWelcomeEmail.description: Specifies if new users will receive a welcome email

lineNumber.description: Required for POST & PUT operations only

sipUsername.description: Required to be globally unique if specified

referenceId.description: Changes Depending on LineType.  If LineType.Line then this should be null.   If LineType.ReferencedUser, PresenceBlfUser, or SpeedDialUser then this should be a valid userid.   If LineType.SpeedDialTn then this should be a valid phone number

holdActivation.description: Use this when activating phone numbers to prevent carrier activation until a later date

callingPlanReferenceId.description: When modifying an existing calling plan list, this is the calling plan product id. When opting to share an existing calling plan list, this is the the reference id that has the calling plan list that the new reference would share.

callingPlanType.description: Indicates if the request is for a change to an existing calling plan list, share a calling plan list with another reference, or stop sharing the configured list with other references.

pending.description: If false then the calling plan change will apply immediately.   If true then the change will take place at the account billing date. Does not apply when the request is to share a calling plan.

minutesUsed.description: Only used on add. Will only be applied to new plans. Will not be applied to pending plans plans. Does not apply when the request is to share a calling plan.

alertInfoHeaderValue.description: sip header for this ring type

fromName.description: callerId name of caller that left message, if available

fromNumber.description: callerId number of caller that left message, if available

lengthInPages.description: length of message in pages, if it is a FAX

lengthInSeconds.description: length of message in pages, if it is a VOICE message

read.description: has the message been seen / opened / read

toPhoneNumber.description: The to number associated with the voicemail message

transcriptionText.description: The resulting text of the transcribed message

storageId.description: The storage id of audio file

voicemailToEmailAddresses.description: email addresses to forward all voicemail messages to

voicemailKeepAfterEmail.description: keep or delete the voicemail after being emailed

referencedBy.description: References that point at this voicemail box

totalUnreadVoicemails.description: Total unread voicemails on the box

subIds.description: List of sub voicemail ids, this will be populated only if this voicemail box is primary

parentId.description: Parent id for this voicemail box. Applicable if this voicemail box is a sub

dtmfOption.description: DTMF option for this voicemail box.  If this voicemail box is a sub, options are 2 through 8 otherwise option must be 1

pinLockedOut.description: Marks whether the pin on this sub voicemailbox has been locked out

messageTranscriptionEnabled.description: Specifies whether voicemail messages will be transcribed to text after a voicemail message is left
